gnis-historic.geojson.caveats: RESULT IS ZERO, VERIFIED THREE WAYS (MN TXT clipped twice incl. an independent recount, and the FullModel GPKG HistoricalFeatures layer clipped the same way: all 0). This is a property of the current GNIS, not a failed pull: the post-2021-rebuild GNIS holds only 129 historical features in all of Minnesota (67 Civil, 25 Census, 21 Populated Place, 9 Military, 3 Lake, 2 Reservoir, 1 Stream, 1 Crossing) and none falls inside HUC8 07010102. The nearest is Cuba (historical), Populated Place, Cass County, GNIS 2071406, ~3 km north of the watershed boundary. The current Minnesota file contains ZERO Post Office features of any status (the class was eliminated in the 2021 rebuild) and zero historical School, Church, Cemetery, Locale, or Dam features statewide, so the requested classes cannot surface from current GNIS at all. The HUC8 clip itself is sound (valid polygon, ~3,450 km2; 459 current-GNIS points fall inside it, including Leech Lake 656980, Leech Lake Reservoir 1776809, and Township of Leech Lake 664746, all verified present in the MN file; 25 in-clip Populated Places, all current, incl. Tobique 658699 and Wilkinson 659012). Lothrop is ABSENT from current GNIS entirely: no hit for Lothrop or Lathrop in DomesticNames, HistoricalFeatures, PopulatedPlaces, or the Gaz_Names variant-names table of the MN GPKG, although it is a documented place (logging boom town on Ten Mile Lake's Long Bay, platted 1895, post office from 22 Dec 1894, ghost town by ~1901; Cass County Museum Clippings Apr 2010; MPCA/DNR 2010 Ten Mile Lake assessment). No burial/cultural-site point was found in this pull (zero features); THPO/Band review not triggered by this dataset. LEGACY-ARCHIVE LEAD (not in the deliverable file; needs a coordinator decision before use): the frozen Aug 2021 GNIS Archive MN file (https://prd-tnm.s3.amazonaws.com/StagedProducts/GeographicNames/Archive/MainDomestic/MN_Features_20210825.txt, 50,552 rows) holds 3,524 historical Minnesota features, and 28 in target classes clip inside the watershed with coordinates (18 Post Office + 10 Locale, e.g. Brevik, Cyphers, Gould, Inguadona, Kabekona, Leech Lake, Nary, Onigum, Pontoria, Raboin, Rosby, Schley, Snowball, Tobique, Wabedo, Wilkinson post offices; Benedict Railroad Station, Boy River, Federal Dam, Guthrie Railroad Station, Laporte, Walker locales), plus 2 historical Airports. The Archive also holds 'Lathrop Post Office (historical)' (GNIS 2071373, Cass County, map Longville) but with coordinates Unknown (0,0), so Lothrop cannot be plotted from GNIS alone; its townsite per the Cass County Museum was slightly south of where County Road 50 meets Highway 371, on Ten Mile Lake's east side (inside the watershed). If the viewer wants a historic-places layer, the honest route is a second, separately labeled file from the Archive (frozen 2021, superseded) plus a hand-placed Lothrop point from the museum/DNR sources, NOT folding archive rows into this current-GNIS file.
gnis-historic.geojson.query: USGS GNIS current data, published 20261102 (bi-monthly refresh). Minnesota state file (DomesticNames_MN_Text.zip, 20,083 rows) spatially clipped to the HUC8 07010102 polygon (scripts/huc8-07010102-clip.geojson), then filtered to historical-flagged features (membership in the Topical HistoricalFeatures extract, https://prd-tnm.s3.amazonaws.com/StagedProducts/GeographicNames/Topical/HistoricalFeatures_National_Text.zip, 26,299 rows national) in classes Post Office, School, Church, Cemetery, Locale, Dam, Populated Place. Cross-checked against the FullModel GeoPackage (https://prd-tnm.s3.amazonaws.com/StagedProducts/GeographicNames/FullModel/Gazetteer_MN_GPKG.zip): DomesticNames 20,083 rows, HistoricalFeatures layer 129 rows, identical result.
